seeded.note: Candidates seeded from a research agent's web-search summaries (see data/leads); unverified until the contest file cites the Secretary of State certified list. No stance questions set yet. Research notes: CONFLICT: Ballotpedia's general-election listing names Erskine Levi (R) as Cisneros's opponent. The SoS San Bernardino County partial results show Ching (REP) about 23.8% and Levi about 15.1%, with Cisneros about 61%. An AP item says Ching advanced in the 31st; its date was not shown, but Ching ran in the 38th in 2022 and 2024, so it is most likely 2026. Ching is the best-supported opponent, but this is not confirmed from the certified list. The LA Almanac labels Cisneros a majority winner and the incumbent (asterisk). No facts were gathered for Cisneros (offices, education, military service) because the web-search budget ran out. Wikipedia has a page for Eric Ching (not read). Incumbent means the current member for district number 31; Prop 50 redrew the boundaries.
